main.title: Fast Response Model (Main)
main.info: The main model prioritizes fast responses to stay companionable: the chat page, desktop pet, avatar workshop, and all platform integrations (QQ / WeChat / Minecraft etc.) use it. It replies instantly, can call tools, and automatically consults memory before replying.
main.infoTip: Prefer fast, low-latency non-thinking models such as GPT-4o-mini, Claude Haiku, or DeepSeek-V3.

reasoner.info: The reasoning model powers the main Agent workbench "Pro mode" for long and complex tasks: plan generation, subtask synthesis, and deep analysis. Everyday companion chats never use it.

hero.title: Privacy First · Compliance Based
hero.desc: LuomiNest is developed by the LuminousChenXi team. We deeply understand the importance of privacy and are committed to protecting your data security and legal compliance. This page explains in detail how this app collects, uses, stores, and protects your information, as well as our legal and regulatory compliance in the major jurisdictions.
